name: Peloponnisos
shape: Eurostat NUTS, the area it is named for

blurb.text: A Greek PGI covering the Peloponnese. Agiorgitiko is the most planted grape at 35 percent of vines, followed by Roditis at 23 percent and Moschofilero at 15 percent.
